description: Conservative cheat-detection configuration for PrepVista (integrity_monitor.py). Each behavioural signal carries a weight, severity, and trigger. The integrity score starts at 100 and subtracts the weighted penalties of triggered signals. Crucially, the system is conservative: it NEVER auto-penalises a student — every flag is for human/TPO review — and a single signal can never push a session past 'needs review'. 'High risk' requires multiple corroborating signals.
philosophy: Protect the credibility of scores without falsely accusing students. When unsure, flag softly for human review rather than penalise.

signals.label: Large paste burst
signals.description: A large block of text appears at once with almost no keystrokes — likely pasted, not typed.

signals.label: Superhuman typing speed
signals.description: Sustained typing speed implausibly high for a person.

signals.label: Verbatim external match
signals.description: Answer matches a known external/canned source near-verbatim.

signals.label: Repeated focus loss
signals.description: The window loses focus multiple times during answering — consistent with looking things up.

signals.label: AI-generated signature
signals.description: Answer shows strong statistical markers of AI-generated text (over-polished, generic structure).

signals.label: Question copied to clipboard
signals.description: The question text was copied — often a precursor to an external search.

signals.label: Implausibly rapid response
signals.description: A complete, complex answer arrives faster than a person could compose it.

signals.label: Idle then instant complete answer
signals.description: A long idle gap followed by an instant, complete answer.

signals.label: Single focus loss
signals.description: The window loses focus once during answering.

signals.label: Copy event
signals.description: A copy action was detected during the session.

signals.label: Answer-quality inconsistency
signals.description: Answer quality swings far beyond the candidate's established level across the session.

signals.label: Proctoring anomaly (if enabled)
signals.description: Camera-based proctoring detects no face or multiple faces (only if proctoring is enabled).

integrity_score.formula: integrity = 100 * (1 - min(1.0, sum(weight of each triggered signal))).
integrity_score.interpretation: Higher is cleaner. The score never goes below 0.
integrity_score.note: Weights are capped so no lone signal dominates; corroboration is what matters.

risk_bands.label: Needs review
risk_bands.meaning: Some signals present; a human should glance at the session before trusting the score.

risk_bands.label: High risk
risk_bands.action: flag prominently; recommend a proctored re-test
risk_bands.meaning: Multiple corroborating signals; treat the score with caution.

grace.note: Don't punish a single tab-switch or a laggy connection.

false_positive_guards.note: A student can be wrongly flagged for innocent reasons; these guards keep the system fair.

proctoring.note: Camera proctoring is opt-in per college; proctoring signals only apply when enabled.

data_handling.note: Store derived signals, not raw keystroke streams, for privacy.
